item.title: Nearly 1,000 bills died this year: What’s in Virginia’s legislative graveyard
item.description: Nearly 1,000 bills introduced in the Virginia General Assembly this year did not make it out of either the House or Senate by crossover. Here are some of the bills that are buried in the 2026 legislative graveyard.

item.title: Justice Department swiftly fires lawyer chosen as U.S. attorney in the Eastern District of Virginia
item.description: James Hundley was fired via social media Friday shortly after he was chosen by judges.

item.title: Kempsville wins 1st gymnastics state championship, Grassfield, Cox, Poquoson lead wrestling tourneys
item.description: Kempsville won the Region A title over Kellam two weeks ago by less than two points and edged the Knights again for the state crown.

item.title: Zach Leite’s two homers power ODU past Niagara
item.description: In other college baseball action, Brayden Mazzoni hit a walk-off RBI double in the bottom of the 10th inning to rally Christopher Newport to a wild 21-20 victory over Marietta.

item.title: Hampton women show growth in rematch against Drexel, but CAA slide continues in tight loss
item.description: After dropping the first matchup by 33, the Pirates led entering the fourth quarter on Friday before a 14-3 run flipped the script late. Kiki McElrath scored a game-high 19 points in Hampton's eighth loss in nine games.

item.title: Admirals force OT with late goal, win thriller after big altercation
item.description: After a second-period brouhaha resulting in several ejections, Brady Fleurent and Jack O'Leary scored two of the Admirals' timeliest goals of the season.

item.title: No. 18 Saint Louis rallies past VCU before benches-clearing incident
item.description: The Rams' 10-game winning streak ends with a second-half drought. Meanwhile, Apprentice School reaches its conference semifinals at home, and the William & Mary women's comeback falls short vs. Monmouth.

item.title: Photos: The Admirals beat Fort Wayne 6-5 in overtime
item.description: Norfolk forward Jack O’Leary scored the game winning goal in overtime to lift the Admirals over the Fort Wayne Komets 5-6 at Scope Arena in Norfolk, Va., on Feb. 20, 2026.

item.title: High school scoreboard: Top-seeded Catholic boys, No. 2 Norfolk Collegiate advance to TCIS basketball final
item.description: Khadijah Rashid led No. 5 seed Grassfield with 20 points in a 71-20 VHSL Class 6 Region A quarterfinal win over J.R. Tucker.

item.title: No. 6 Virginia Tech captures outright ACC regular-season wrestling title
item.description: The Hokies won six of 10 matches over Duke on Senior Night in Cassell Coliseum to give coach Tony Robie and company their ninth conference title since he took the helm in Blacksburg.
